howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in and navigate to the Career section under the Recruitment tab.

howToApply: Visit the Commission’s website psc.uk.gov.in or pscuk.net.in to read the advertisement carefully.

After reading the advertisement, go to pscuk.net.in and click on the ‘How to Apply’ link in the Menubar. Review Advertisement Details, Important Dates, and Instructions for filling up the online application form, then click on ‘Apply Now’.

After clicking ‘Apply Now’, fill in the required correct information on the Registration Form, create a Password for Login, and click ‘Submit’. After submission, the Basic Information entered will be displayed. Verify all details carefully. If correct, tick ‘I have verified all the details entered by me in the registration form and wish to submit the same’ and click Submit. Otherwise, tick ‘No, I want to change some details’, click Edit, correct the details, and complete the Registration Form submission again.

After clicking Submit, information about Primary Registration completion will be displayed on screen, and a message will be received on the Registered Mobile Number and Email. Then click on ‘Click here to login’ button on screen.

After Login, the Educational Details page will be displayed. Fill in High School details and click ‘Add Education Details’. The filled details will be displayed in the grid below. In case of wrong educational details, click Edit/Delete icon in the grid to Edit or Delete. Similarly fill in Intermediate, Graduate and other educational qualifications. Fill other details on the form and click Continue. Then upload Photo and Signature on the ‘Photo & Signature to Upload’ tab as per the displayed instructions. To re-upload Photo/Signature, click on ‘I want to upload photo and signature’ Checkbox and re-upload.

After uploading Photo and Signature, tick the declaration ‘I hereby declare that the photograph & signature are correct and accurate representation of myself’ and click Continue. The data filled in the form will be displayed on screen. Check the filled details carefully. Wrong details can be corrected by clicking ‘Back & Edit’ button to go back to the form. When all details are correct, tick the declaration and click the Final Button to complete the online application process. Click ‘Print Application’ button to get a printout of the online application form.

After Final Submission, if there is an error in the application form, the candidate can cancel the application (Cancel My Application button) and apply again. However, the fee paid will not be refunded; the candidate must pay the fee again for the revised/new online application form.
